CBS Portfolio Dashboard - wo Personal Data — North America
Maintained by the CBS Delivery Operations team Refreshed every Monday
Portfolio Overview
Financial summary of the full North America services portfolio. Tracks Contract Baseline Revenue, EAC, Actual Revenue and Margin metrics across all delivery buckets.
Portfolio Analysis
Project-level breakdown with CBS Managed vs. SPOT segmentation, Project Management Responsibility distribution, SAP Margin Status and MANDI health indicators.
Leakage Analysis
Revenue at risk at Sales Order level. Identifies positive (Red) and critical negative (Orange) leakage by contract type and bucket. Surfaces critical customer exposure.
Red Report
Weekly tracking of projects in the CBS Red Report. Monitors new entries, recidivism, issue resolution events and root-cause Standard Comment categories.
